name: Lush stereo saw pad with scale-snapped pitch texture
goal: Make a lush ambient pad: dual saws panned L/R with ±5 cent fine tune, 4-voice unison ~3% detune, dirty 12 dB filter with drive/resonance, dual envelopes (amp + filter), stereo random → cutoff, then a third osc with scale-snapped random pitch/pan, squeeze distortion, global voice detune drift, noise sample, and reverb+ping-pong delay.

source.title: How to make LUSH ambient pads in Vital

prerequisites: Synth with ≥3 osc, unison, random mods, pitch snap/scale lock, distortion, delay, reverb

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: Scale for pitch snapping the texture osc

outputs.name: lush_ambient_pad
outputs.description: Wide lush pad with melodic random texture

constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided captions; do not invent UI or settings.
Original synthesis only — map brand UI (Serum/Vital/Pigments/Phase Plant/etc.) to portable osc/filter/FX roles for a browser or generic hybrid synth; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable signal-flow and motion relationships over vendor-specific preset names.

steps.action: Osc1+2: basic saws; pan opposite; fine-tune ~±5 cents.
Add ~4 unison voices @ ~3% detune for depth.
Filter1 dirty/12 dB on both oscs; set drive and resonance; env1 mid attack/decay/sustain + longer release for level.
Env2: short attack, long decay, sustain <50%, release up → filter cutoff for per-chord harmonic bloom; also stereo random (1 bar) → cutoff.
steps.expect: Movement at chord starts + ongoing variation

steps.action: Osc3 texture: random (sine-interpolate, ~5.2s) → transpose with scale snap + global snap; +12 st base; map same random to pan (stereo mode for independent movers).
Squeeze/distort osc3 via macro; optional random → fine pitch; slow stereo random → global voice detune (bipolar) for analog warp.
Sample noise (e.g. HVAC) keytrack off; filter2 on osc3+sample; reverb ~50% mix; ping-pong delay 1/4; re-enable osc1/2.

verification: Texture osc stays in chosen scale when snapping enabled
Reverb/delay present without killing dry chord definition entirely
